postings.title: Customer Service Representative (Phone Support)
postings.description:
Customer Service Representative (Phone Support)

- 100% Remote (must reside in the continental United States)

- Full-time / salaried position

- $45k - $55k first year total annual compensation + Benefits + PTO 

ARIVE is a high-growth software startup that is redefining digital mortgage originations by building the industry’s first Wholesale Originations Marketplace, which connects independent loan originators, industry-leading lenders, borrowers, referral partners, credit providers, and property and settlement service providers into one seamless loan origination platform.

ARIVE is seeking an intelligent, well-spoken, and ambitious Customer Service Representative to primarily provide frontline phone support to our users. You will be part of ARIVE’s diverse team of problem solvers and play a critical role in ensuring accelerated customer service and support of our world-class lending platform. Working here means you get to do work that creates a meaningful, sustainable impact surrounded by the very best people.

General Description

Support of ARIVE is provided through channels including instant chat, email, phone, and social media platforms. You would act as the initial phone support representative for ARIVE clients and users of the ARIVE software, assisting users with general use questions, basic troubleshooting, and proper routing of support escalations and sales inquiries. This is primarily a remote position and candidates must be located in the US.

Role and Responsibilities

- Act as an initial point of contact for phone inquiries, addressing what can be addressed on the phone and properly routing tasks which should be addressed by other teams.

- Provide top-tier customer support, while appropriately addressing call volume and communicating relevant information when rerouting traffic.

- Keep up to date on major system features, client use cases, marketing materials, and event schedules so as to competently discuss them and answer related questions on phone calls.

- Review voicemails for callback opportunities and reroute callback responsibilities to the appropriate parties.

- Adaptively navigate team and company protocols to best address or divert client calls efficiently.

- Maintain records and awareness of call volume and call topics to aid teams in identifying strategies to proactively address volume and user pain points.

Things We Look For:

The ideal applicant will be able to quickly learn about the complexities of the mortgage industry on the job and actively apply their newfound knowledge toward solving business and technical problems. This must also be done in a manner which builds and maintains strong positive client relationships even when under pressure.

- Minimum 2+ years of relevant customer support experience, including phone support.

- Experience working in the mortgage industry is strongly preferred.

- Ability to communicate well over the phone in English, including calming difficult clients and communicating complex information verbally.

- Calm demeanor and people skills, with the ability to maintain that demeanor under stress.

- Self-motivation, willingness to learn, to practice or rehearse in the software system, and to independently research.

- Ability to thrive in an unstructured, fast-paced environment and efficiently manage time while balancing priority and quality versus quantity moment to moment.

- High level of integrity and a strong commitment to building a successful company and nurturing customer relationships.

- Prior experience in speaking with business owners and executives, as well as relationship management experience, are a plus.

What We Offer

- Annual salary range for this full-time position is $45,000 - $55,000 (exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

- Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Benefits

- 401(k) Plan (with employer match)

- Generous PTO

- Endless learning in a fast-paced, growth-mode startup

** Please do not contact employees or ARIVE support directly to inquire about this, or other career opportunities **

Note: ARIVE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

postings.title: Global Head of People & Talent
postings.description:
Global Head of People and Talent

- Location: San Ramon, CA (Hybrid; 3 days per week in office)

- Compensation: $150,000 – $200,000 + up to 20% bonus

About ARIVE and the Role

ARIVE is a privately held, founder-led fintech transforming digital mortgage originations with the industry's first Wholesale Originations Marketplace. We empower local loan originators to deliver best-fit, personalized mortgages from a vast network of lenders. Our feature-rich loan origination platform is mission-critical for the tens of thousands of originators who rely on it every day.

We are profitable and growing rapidly - currently ~45 employees in the US and 130+ engineers at our India subsidiary - and building the leadership team and organizational design that will carry ARIVE through its next phase of growth and scale.

We are looking for a Global Head of People and Talent - a strategic, hands-on leader and trusted advisor to the CEO who will own ARIVE's people function end-to-end, including organizational design, talent acquisition, employee development, performance, and culture. You will partner closely with functional heads to build a high-performance organization, collaborate openly with employees across every level and geography, and embody the ARIVE core values and culture in everything you do - leading the people function to ensure ARIVE remains agile and nimble, aligns employee expectations, and strengthens engagement through rapid growth.

Core Responsibilities

- Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO on organizational design, key hiring decisions, talent management and people-related matters that shape the company; bring market intelligence, peer benchmarks, and best-practice recommendations that inform decisions and translate strategy into a multi-year workforce plan across the US and India.

- Implement organizational design across functions in close partnership with each functional leader - team structures, leveling, people development, and succession planning - and own the operating rhythm for planning, performance, and talent review cycles.

- Design and run performance management, calibration, and feedback cycles that raise the bar and help every employee do their best work.
Operationalize ARIVE's compensation framework - base, bonus, and benefits - tied directly to performance reviews and measurable business and individual outcomes, with regular market research and benchmarking against SaaS peers and comparable companies to inform leadership decisions.

- Manage health, retirement, PTO, and employee wellness programs with the same rigor applied to every other investment.

- Build and maintain HR policies, employee handbooks, job titles and descriptions, mandatory state trainings (anti-harassment, workplace safety, and other state-required programs), and compliance controls across multi-state US operations and intercompany coordination with our India subsidiary.

- Oversee employee records, contracts, and the full employee lifecycle with discretion and sound judgment on sensitive matters - investigations, performance exits, and leadership changes.

- Elevate ARIVE's employer brand across the tech ecosystem and our key talent markets; lead the US recruiting team on new hires and provide oversight and alignment for India hiring with India HR leadership.

- Design new-hire onboarding and employee development programs that accelerate time-to-impact and growth, and anchor every joiner in ARIVE's mission, values, and ways of working; create career pathing, internal mobility, and development frameworks - including manager and leadership capability building - that help employees grow with the company.

- Champion recognition, celebration, and internal communication programs that reinforce ARIVE's values through direct engagement with employees at every level and geography; own engagement measurement and listening programs (pulse, engagement, exit) and the response programs that follow.

- Partner with the CEO and functional leaders to bring AI-forward thinking to workforce strategy - assess how AI is reshaping roles, identify reskilling and upskilling needs, and embed AI tools and practices into how the people function itself operates (recruiting, onboarding, performance, HR ops).

What We're Looking For

- 15+ years experience in Human Resources.

- 5+ years in senior people leadership roles, with meaningful time in high-growth technology companies.

- Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or SHRM/HRCI certification a plus.

- Experience scaling people functions across distributed teams and multiple locations or time zones as the senior-most leader or a strong second-in-command ready to step into the top role.

- Proven ability to design high-performance organizations in partnership with strong functional leaders.

- Strong command of compensation strategy in technology companies.

- Ability to operate as both a trusted advisor to a founder-CEO and a hands-on builder who will write the people operations handbook, run calibrations, and stay close to the day-to-day people decisions across the company.

- Exceptional judgment and discretion with sensitive people data and related matters.

- Data-driven decision-making — reaches for the numbers before the narrative, balanced with empathy and sound instinct.

- AI-forward perspective on how technology is reshaping work, roles, and the people function itself - with practical experience deploying AI tools and frameworks within an HR organization.

What We Offer

- Compensation: The US base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 – $200,000 + up to 20% performance-based bonus. The position is eligible for performance-based equity compensation. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level, and role; individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

- Location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA (Hybrid): 2-3 days per week in office, with remote flexibility on other days.

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

- 401(k) plan with employer match.

- Generous PTO policy.

Logistics

- Must be based in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to work from ARIVE's San Ramon HQ 3 days per week.

- Relocation assistance available for eligible candidates.

- Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Note: ARIVE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

postings.title: Head of Marketing
postings.description:
Head of Marketing

Location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Hybrid 3 days per week from our San Ramon office, with remote flexibility on other days

About ARIVE

ARIVE (www.arive.com) is a dynamic, high-growth software company revolutionizing digital mortgage originations by building the industry's first Wholesale Originations Marketplace. Our all-in-one Cloud LOS, POS, PPE, and Dual AUS ecosystem seamlessly connects independent loan originators, top-tier wholesale lenders, borrowers, referral partners, credit providers, and property and settlement service providers - creating a faster, more transparent, and more affordable path to homeownership.

Position Overview

We're seeking a strategic, growth-focused Head of Marketing to scale ARIVE's brand, community, and demand generation as we cement our position as the de facto tech stack for independent mortgage brokers and wholesale lenders. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own market positioning, brand strategy, product marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), events, and community/partner marketing — inheriting an experienced Marketing Manager, building out the marketing department, and evolving our marketing engine from foundational execution into a highly scalable, data-driven growth function. Join us to make a meaningful, sustainable impact alongside some of the industry's brightest minds.

Key Responsibilities

- Brand, Product Marketing & Positioning: Translate complex features (Cloud LOS, POS, PPE, and Dual AUS integrations) into clear, high-value narratives that speak directly to the pain points of busy independent loan officers and wholesale lenders. Own brand voice, visual identity, and thought leadership (webinars, case studies, PR, bylined content). Lead product marketing for new features and releases - launch narratives, announcements, and go-live communications orchestrated across email, in-app, social, web, PR, and sales-enablement channels. Champion ARIVE’s presence in industry awards and recognition programs (e.g., HousingWire Tech100) - own the submissions calendar and turn wins into brand-credibility moments across channels.

- Community & Partner Marketing: Deepen ARIVE's highly engaged broker community and strategic industry partnerships (e.g., AIME, NAMB, Agencies etc.) to drive organic advocacy, referral loops, and brand loyalty. Spotlight ARIVE representations at industry conventions and cultivate relationships with association leadership and key opinion leaders. Treat our loyal, highly active user community as a strategic asset - deepen ARIVE’s brand positioning and voice within it through champion/advocacy programs, customer stories, and community-led content. Own ARIVE’s hosted-event strategy end-to-end - user conference, roadshows, and webinar series - with clear engagement and pipeline goals for each.

- Marketing Strategy & Planning: Define and execute the marketing roadmap to expand broker adoption and deepen wholesale lender marketplace engagement. Partner closely with Product, Sales, Onboarding, Support, Compliance, and Executive Leadership to successfully launch new products, integrations, and strategic initiatives. Own one unified annual marketing plan spanning brokers and wholesale lenders - with clear pipeline, CAC/LTV, and brand-health targets - define ICPs and segment-specific value propositions, and align with Sales on shared goals, SLAs, and feedback loops.

- ABM, Demand Generation & Customer Marketing: Build and run a tiered ABM program for high-value wholesale lenders and top broker shops - joint account selection and tiering with Sales, personalized multi-channel plays (content, events, digital, outbound air cover), and account-level engagement, pipeline, and expansion reporting. Build a multi-channel demand generation strategy (content, SEO, events, paid media, lifecycle/email) to consistently drive high-quality platform sign-ups; own the MarTech stack and attribution reporting. Plan, launch, and optimize integrated campaigns end-to-end across channels, using analytics to read performance and reallocate budget to what works. Own the marketing content and strategy delivered to broker and lender customers through the ARIVE platform itself - in-app announcements, lifecycle campaigns, marketplace placements and lender spotlights, and adoption/education content that deepens engagement and retention.

- Team Leadership, Budget & Executive Reporting: Direct, mentor, and grow the marketing team (beginning with the existing Marketing Manager). Manage the annual marketing budget with a strict eye on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV). Design the marketing org and hiring roadmap, recruit and develop top talent, set clear goals and career paths, and leverage agencies/contractors as force multipliers while instilling an accountable, metrics-driven culture. Keep the CEO and executive leadership informed on marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and brand health through regular metrics reviews.

Things We Look For

- Experience: 10+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in a Director/Head-of leadership role within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or PropTech.

- Industry Knowledge: Deep familiarity with mortgage technology, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Point-of-Sale (POS) platforms, or the independent mortgage broker channel strongly preferred. Experience marketing to loan originators, brokers, or wholesale lenders — with fluency in the channel’s language, communities, and events — is a strong plus.

- Brand & Community Builder: Proven track record building brand affinity and leveraging user communities (Facebook groups, association partnerships, live industry events) to fuel product-led, organic growth.

- Full-Stack Marketing Mindset: Equal parts strategic brand architect and hands-on growth marketer — comfortable in Google Analytics/attribution dashboards as well as guiding a product launch or PR campaign.

- ABM Expertise: Hands-on success designing and scaling account-based marketing for named/enterprise accounts — segmentation, orchestration, and measurement (e.g., HubSpot ABM) — in tight partnership with Sales.

- MarTech Fluency: Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce) and analytics/BI tools (GA4, Looker, or Tableau).

- Leadership: Strong people-management skills with experience building and mentoring a marketing team; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-paced startup. Demonstrated success building a marketing department from an early stage — org design, hiring, coaching, and performance management — and leading through rapid growth and change.

- Communication: Excellent written/verbal communication and executive presence; able to represent ARIVE externally (press, panels, conventions) and report clearly to the CEO.

- Regulated-Industry Awareness: Working knowledge of advertising/compliance considerations in mortgage marketing (e.g., RESPA, state licensing rules) is a plus; all external claims are reviewed in partnership with Legal/Compliance.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred; MBA a plus.

What We Offer

- Compensation: The US base salary range for this full-time position is $180,000 – $250,000 + up to 20% performance-based bonus. The position is eligible for performance-based equity compensation. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level, and role; individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

- Location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA (Hybrid): 3-4 days per week in office, with remote flexibility on other days. Relocation assistance available for eligible candidates.

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

- 401(k) plan with employer match.

- Generous PTO policy.

- Endless learning and growth opportunities in a fast-paced, high-growth startup.

Note: ARIVE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
postings.description:
Senior Software Engineer – Backend

- Location: Hybrid from our San Ramon, CA office (3 days a week) preferred; Will consider 100% remote for non-local candidates (core work hours 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time)

- Compensation: The US base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 – $180,000 + up to 15% performance-based bonus. The position is eligible for performance-based equity compensation.

- Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

About ARIVE

ARIVE (arive.com) is the industry's first integrated LOS, POS, and Pricing Engine with a connected Lender Marketplace, purpose-built for independent mortgage originators. We are a dynamic high-growth company revolutionizing digital mortgage originations, and our platform seamlessly connects independent loan originators, top-tier wholesale lenders, borrowers, referral partners, credit providers, and property and settlement service providers — creating a faster, more transparent, and more affordable path to homeownership.

Position Overview

We're seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer to design, support, and scale the services at the heart of the ARIVE platform — the engine powering loan originations for thousands of independent mortgage brokers nationwide. You'll work hands-on with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and Docker, partnering closely with product, frontend, and DevOps teams to ship high-quality, cloud-native features at startup speed.

A key part of this role is production ownership — partnering with our support team to troubleshoot at-scale production issues, driving root cause to resolution, and hardening the platform so problems stay fixed. You'll also coordinate closely with our US architects and India-based engineering team for new features. This is a high-ownership role for an engineer who loves solving hard distributed-systems and data problems in a domain where reliability, performance, and security truly matter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of major workstreams alongside our most senior architects — freeing them to focus on next-generation platform initiatives. Join us and make a meaningful, sustainable impact alongside some of the industry's brightest minds.

Key Responsibilities

- Design & Build: Architect, develop, and maintain scalable RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js and TypeScript, powering mission-critical loan origination workflows.

- Data Engineering: Design efficient database schemas and optimize queries and migrations across PostgreSQL and MongoDB; implement caching strategies (e.g., Redis) for high-throughput workloads.

- Cloud & Containers: Build, test, and deploy containerized applications with Docker; deploy and operate services on AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS).

- DevOps Collaboration: Partner with DevOps to strengthen CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).

- Reliability & Security: Champion system reliability, performance, and secure coding best practices — our platform handles sensitive borrower data, and we operate in a SOC 2 Type II environment where security is a first-class engineering concern.

- Production Ownership: Partner with our Support team as an engineering point of contact for escalated production issues at scale — triage, root-cause, and resolve end-to-end, then land the permanent fix, alerting, and runbooks so issues don’t recur. Drive performance optimization across the backend and data layers.

- Global Collaboration: Coordinate daily with our India-based engineering team — handoffs, code reviews, and design alignment — keeping core hours of 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT to maximize morning overlap.

- Technical Leadership: Lead technical design sessions and code reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and contribute to product planning and architectural roadmaps.

Things We Look For

- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience with most, if not all, of the following: Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and Docker.

- API & Systems Design: Strong command of RESTful API design, microservices and event-driven architectures, and message queues (e.g., SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ).

- Data Fluency: Deep experience with both relational and NoSQL data modeling, query optimization, indexing strategies, and zero-downtime migrations.

- Quality Mindset: Solid habits around automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), code review, and CI/CD; you ship fast without breaking things.

- Security Awareness: Working knowledge of secure SDLC practices — authN/authZ patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), OWASP Top 10, and handling sensitive data in a regulated environment.

- Observability: Experience with monitoring and APM tooling (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic) and a bias toward measuring before optimizing.

- Escalation Experience: You’ve served as an engineering point of contact for support escalations and stay calm and methodical when debugging live production systems under pressure.

- AI-Forward: You leverage AI coding tools to maximize your speed and output — and are excited to help build AI-powered capabilities into the platform.

- Startup DNA: Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity; you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment and communicate clearly across teams.

- Bonus Points: FinTech, mortgage, or other regulated-industry experience; familiarity with LOS/POS platforms or the loan origination lifecycle is a strong plus.

What We Offer

- Compensation: The US base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 – $180,000 + up to 15% performance-based bonus. The position is eligible for performance-based equity compensation. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level, and role; individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

- 401(k) plan with employer match.

- Generous PTO policy.

- Endless learning and growth opportunities in a fast-paced, growth-mode startup environment.

- A supportive, inclusive, and high-performance company culture.

Note: ARIVE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.
